items_flat.title_en: Anthropic closes record IPO with full underwriter option and concurrent private placement
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic完成創紀錄IPO，全額行使承銷選擇權並同步私募
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced the closing of its IPO of 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83.00, including full exercise of the underwriters’ option for an additional 147 million shares. Gross proceeds from the public offering were about $93.5 billion, of which Anthropic received roughly $91.6 billion; a concurrent private placement of Class N shares to hardware providers raised about $26 billion.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布完成其首次公開發行，以每股83美元發行11.27億股A類普通股，並全額行使承銷商額外購買1.47億股的選擇權。公開發行總募集約935億美元，其中公司取得約916億美元；同步向硬體供應商私募N類股約260億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The close locks in the largest IPO on record and pairs public capital with strategic hardware-provider investment, giving Anthropic substantial balance-sheet strength while embedding major chipmakers as shareholders. Execution of the underwriters’ option and the private placement both at the IPO price signal strong demand, though post-listing trading performance and capital allocation remain to be observed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此次完成鎖定史上最大IPO，並將公開資本與策略硬體供應商投資結合，大幅強化Anthropic資產負債表，同時使主要晶片商成為股東。承銷選擇權與私募均以IPO價格執行顯示需求強勁，但上市後交易表現與資金配置仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日Anthropic, PBC宣布完成其首次公開發行，以每股83.00美元的公開發行價格發行合計11.27億股A類普通股，包括承銷商全額行使以首次公開發行價格向Anthropic額外購買1.47億股A類普通股的選擇權。

items_flat.title_en: Lean and Mathlib communities certify Anthropic mathematician’s Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis formalization
items_flat.title_zh: Lean與Mathlib社群認證Anthropic數學家與Claude合作的黎曼猜想形式化
items_flat.summary_en: Levent Alpöge posted a note stating he and Claude discovered a proof of the Riemann hypothesis (and generalized form), released only as a Lean formalization of roughly 17 million lines. On November 21 the Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement, endorsed by the Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative, certifying that both the statement and the proof are correct after compilation, statement-comparison, and multi-kernel checks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Levent Alpöge在個人網站發布說明，稱他與Claude發現黎曼猜想（及廣義形式）的證明，僅以約1700萬行的Lean形式化釋出。11月21日Lean與Mathlib社群發表聯合聲明（獲Lean FRO與Mathlib Initiative背書），經編譯、陳述比對與多核心檢查後，認證陳述與證明均正確。
items_flat.analysis_en: Community certification of the Lean formalization removes a major technical objection and elevates the claim from unverified announcement to machine-checked result. A conventional human-readable paper is still absent, so mathematical understanding and independent conceptual review remain open; the scale of the AI-generated artifact also raises questions about how such proofs will be digested and taught.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 社群認證Lean形式化移除主要技術疑慮，使主張從未驗證宣布提升為機器檢查結果。仍缺乏傳統可讀論文，數學理解與獨立概念審查仍待進行；AI生成工件的規模也引發此類證明如何消化與教學的問題。
items_flat.quote: We have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們對Alpöge的黎曼猜想證明正確性具有完全信心，並恭喜他達成此成就。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details defenses that sharply reduce protected-reasoning extraction
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI詳述大幅降低保護推理提取的防禦措施
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it combats adversarial distillation—unauthorized use of model outputs or reasoning to train another model. It strengthened protections for protected reasoning in GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol. In internal adaptive black-box red-team tests the average success rate for recovering protected reasoning from an earlier request fell from 54.0% on GPT-6 Astra (original safeguards) to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra (updated safeguards).
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布對抗對抗性蒸餾（未經授權使用模型輸出或推理訓練另一模型）的方法，並強化GPT-6.2 Astra與Sol對保護推理的防護。內部自適應黑盒紅隊測試顯示，從先前請求恢復保護推理的平均成功率，從原有防護的GPT-6 Astra的54.0%降至更新防護的GPT-6.2 Astra的0.2%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The large drop in extraction success is OpenAI’s own adaptive red-team result and has not been independently reproduced; it indicates stronger request-level and campaign-level controls but leaves open how well the same protections hold on third-party hosts or against future attack techniques.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 提取成功率大幅下降是OpenAI自身自適應紅隊結果，尚未獨立重現；顯示請求層與活動層控制強化，但第三方託管或未來攻擊手法下的有效性仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: The average attack success rate fell from 54.0% against GPT‑6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% against GPT‑6.2 Astra with its updated safeguards.
items_flat.quote_zh: 平均攻擊成功率從針對原有防護的GPT-6 Astra的54.0%降至針對更新防護的GPT-6.2 Astra的0.2%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces MedChemBench for medicinal-chemistry reasoning
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出藥物化學推理基準MedChemBench
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released MedChemBench, a 99-problem benchmark drawn from 117 papers and patents covering 761 molecular structures. It evaluates models on reconstructing structures, explaining evidence, ranking/selecting compounds and predicting properties. At xhigh reasoning GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% of available credit; structure reconstruction was strong while compound selection and numerical property prediction remained weaker.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布MedChemBench，包含99個問題，取材自117篇論文與專利、涵蓋761個分子結構。評估模型重建結構、解釋證據、排序/選擇化合物與預測性質。在xhigh推理設定下GPT-6.2 Astra取得可用分數的84.5%；結構重建強，但化合物選擇與數值性質預測較弱。
items_flat.analysis_en: The benchmark isolates where current frontier models remain weak (compound selection and numerical property prediction) despite strong structure reconstruction, giving a clearer signal for drug-discovery-relevant reasoning. Only OpenAI models are scored, so cross-lab comparison is not yet available.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 基準清楚指出當前前沿模型在結構重建強勢下，仍弱於化合物選擇與數值性質預測，為藥物發現相關推理提供更明確信號。目前僅評分OpenAI模型，跨實驗室比較尚未可得。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing MedChemBench, a benchmark that evaluates AI models on reasoning tasks drawn from medicinal chemistry research.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出MedChemBench，一個評估AI模型在藥物化學研究推理任務上表現的基準。

items_flat.title_en: Meta shares Open Source AI for Science Summit highlights, including UMA Nitro
items_flat.title_zh: Meta分享開源AI科學峰會亮點，包含UMA Nitro
items_flat.summary_en: Meta’s FAIR team recapped its Open Source AI for Science Summit. It expanded the Digital Brain Project data target from 15,000 to 25,000 hours, released UMA Nitro (a faster Universal Model for Atoms) that has identified crystal forms of drug molecules, and demonstrated enzyme simulations and assistive robotics built on open models such as DINOv3 and SAM 3.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta FAIR團隊回顧開源AI科學峰會。數位大腦計畫數據目標從15,000小時擴至25,000小時，釋出更快的通用原子模型UMA Nitro（已識別藥物分子晶型），並展示以DINOv3與SAM 3等開放模型建構的酶模擬與輔助機器人。
items_flat.analysis_en: The releases continue Meta’s open-weights science strategy, making atomic-scale simulation and formalized mathematics more accessible to academic partners. Real-world impact depends on independent validation of the reported crystal-form and enzyme results and on uptake beyond Meta’s own collaborations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些發布延續Meta開放權重科學策略，使原子尺度模擬與形式化數學對學術夥伴更易取得。實際影響取決於所報晶型與酶結果的獨立驗證，以及合作範圍外的採用情況。
items_flat.quote: At the summit, we released UMA Nitro, a faster version of Meta’s Universal Model for Atoms.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在峰會上，我們釋出UMA Nitro，Meta通用原子模型的更快版本。
